answer.question: What does TEAM International do for healthcare organizations?
answer.text: TEAM International is a healthcare software development company that builds, integrates and automates the healthcare IT solutions providers, payers and digital health companies run on: patient and care apps, EHR integration, claims and revenue-cycle automation, and data. Health systems such as Wellstar and Lovelace Health System use our automation, delivered with HIPAA-compliant practices.
answer.segmentsIntro: Mid-size healthcare and wellness organizations that need enterprise-grade engineering, plus large health systems that need a long-term team.

focus.title: Healthcare IT solutions we build and run

items.title: Patient, care and wellness apps

items.text: EHR integration services and EMR integration that connect your apps, documents and labs to the patient record, with HL7 integration and FHIR APIs as part of broader healthcare interoperability solutions.

items.title: Healthcare automation and data

items.proof: In production: continuous development and support of a medical alert (PERS) platform used by end users, dealers and partners (since 2021).

steps.intro: Every engagement starts with an assessment, and compliance is part of every step, not a final check.

delivery.title: Your language, your market, your time zone
delivery.text: North American healthcare organizations work with our Medellín delivery center; European clients work with our teams in Ukraine. All locations are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we deliver under HIPAA and GDPR requirements.

items.q: What does a healthcare software development company do?
items.a: Healthcare software development companies design, build, integrate and support the software providers, payers and digital health companies run on: patient and care apps, portals, EHR integrations, automation and data platforms. Software development for healthcare also has to meet privacy and security rules such as HIPAA from day one.

items.q: What healthcare software development services does TEAM International offer?
items.a: Four areas: patient, care and wellness apps; EHR integration and interoperability; healthcare automation and data; and compliance, testing and managed IT. As a medical software development company we work for hospitals, clinics, payers and digital health companies.

items.q: Can you integrate with our EHR?
items.a: Yes. We connect apps, documents and data to the patient record through EHR vendor APIs, HL7 interfaces and FHIR, and automate the steps that staff still do by hand. Wellstar uses our automation to link medical documents to the right patient record.

items.q: How do you handle HIPAA and data security?
items.a: HIPAA-compliant practices are part of how we design, build and test: access controls, encryption, audit trails and security reviews in every release. All TEAM locations are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we also work under GDPR.

items.q: What results has healthcare automation delivered?
items.a: Published results include 80% fewer claim denials and more than $1 million saved per year at Texas Center for Lifestyle Medicine, 6,700+ staff hours saved per year and a 63% lower cost per registry at Lovelace Health System, and over 90% accuracy in the first month at Wellstar.

items.q: How is AI used in healthcare operations today?
items.a: The most practical uses of AI in healthcare operations are documentation, claims and patient service. Experian Health's 2025 State of Claims survey found that 41% of providers face denial rates of 10% or higher, while only 14% use AI in claims, so automation and AI on clean data have a clear payback.

items.q: Do you work with mid-size healthcare and wellness companies?
items.a: Yes. Mid-size providers, digital health and wellness companies are our focus; they get the same practices we use for large health systems such as Wellstar.

With a Healthcare Discovery & Modernization Assessment. From there you choose a dedicated team, project delivery or support; healthcare IT outsourcing with TEAM means one accountable team, not a pool of contractors.
